name: grief-month
description: A month shaped by a death. Tests that the voice accompanies rather than explains.

notes.title: The service
notes.text: We buried her on Tuesday. I read the passage she had underlined and could not finish it.

notes.title: Quiet house
notes.text: The house is very quiet now. I keep making two cups of tea.

notes.title: Anger
notes.text: I am angrier than I expected to be, and not at anyone in particular.
